hypothesis_or_artifact: Closure causal diagnosis of the realized under-power, and the ADR-014 dormant observation that the model leaned against momentum (REGISTRATION.md Closure, DECISIONS.md ADR-014, progress.md Z.1, evaluation.md Appendix)
label: DERIVED
claim_quote: The cause is recorded. The realized daily contrast standard deviation came in at **0.36339** against a registered assumption of at most **0.2626**, driven by a strong negative correlation between the model and momentum daily ICs that fell outside the range the registration contemplated.
evidence_summary: The correlation was never measured; it was inferred from the contrast sd under the assumption that both daily IC series carry the null sd 0.185695 (assumption stated at evaluation.md:224-227 and encoded at src/npd/power.py:107-109). Recomputed from the 404 evaluable primary-horizon days (live var/npd.db model_ranking and baseline_ranking joined to live var/npd_sealed.db forward_return horizon 5, read 2026-09-03T06:32:54Z, UNANCHORED): corr(model daily IC, mom_12_1 daily IC) = +0.1182, n = 404. Realized per-series daily IC sds: model 0.25159, mom_12_1 0.29364, logistic 0.29276, sign_last 0.25597, against the assumed 0.185695 (every series 35 to 58 percent above the null sd). The identity sqrt(0.25159^2 + 0.29364^2 - 2*0.1182*0.25159*0.29364) = 0.363389 reproduces the published 0.36339 (evaluation.md:82) exactly, so the inflation is entirely per-series dispersion at a mildly POSITIVE correlation, not a correlation near minus one. ADR-007 registered a correlation-range risk (DECISIONS.md:126-128; grid correlations=(0.0,0.3,0.5,0.7) at power.py:103), not a dispersion risk, so 'ADR-007 registered this failure mode' (REGISTRATION.md:704-705) is false as stated. The registered overlap penalty was over-estimated, not under: realized effective n 201.2 on 404 days (evaluation.md:92) implies a realized VIF of 2.0 against the registered 3.4 (REGISTRATION.md:225).
recomputation: Inputs: model_ranking (415 days) and baseline_ranking (3 x 432 days) from live var/npd.db; forward_return horizon 5 from live var/npd_sealed.db; evaluable-day rule and daily_ic copied from src/npd/eval/evaluator.py:96-133 and :482-506; null sd 1/sqrt(29)=0.185695 from REGISTRATION.md:203-204. Method: daily Spearman IC per series, sample sd (ddof 1), Pearson correlation between the model and momentum series, and the difference-of-series identity. Result: corr = +0.1182 (n 404); sd_model = 0.25159; sd_mom = 0.29364; sd_contrast = 0.363389 (matches evaluation.md:82). Counterfactual: at the realized correlation with null sds the projected MDC would have been 2*sqrt(2*(1-0.1182))*0.185695/sqrt(125.6) = 0.0440 (0.0348 at the realized effective n 201.2); the realized 0.0512 is explained by per-series sd, not by correlation. Script scratchpad/work/agentA/recompute.py, output recompute.out.
would_resolve: Replace the inferred correlation in the Closure, ADR-014, progress.md Z.1 and the evaluation Appendix with the measured value (+0.118, n 404) and the measured per-series sds; restate the cause of the under-power as a registration-stage modelling assumption (null-sd daily ICs for real cross-sectional returns) rather than a model behaviour; correct 'ADR-007 registered this failure mode' to say the registered risk was correlation, not dispersion; withdraw or re-base the dormant observation. The per-series dispersion of the three mechanical baselines was measurable before any spend on the 711-day fit period in var/npd_fit.db (reports/stage_b0/build.md:75-79, 85-88), subject to registering a reader for that store.
confidence_why: The correlation and the sds are direct computations on the stored rankings and sealed returns and reproduce every published figure to four decimals.
invalidation_note: HEAD of the live repository equals the anchored SHA; the only post-anchor artefact is an untracked closure marker dated 2026-09-02 that changes no result.

hypothesis_or_artifact: Section 14 B.3 replay schedule (the registered reopen path for Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8 Max, GLM-5.2) and the power floor the code enforces
label: DERIVED
claim_quote: Each model replays when the calendar grows its clean window past the registered power floor, detectable IC 0.025 at 30 names, which needs roughly 221 trading days after its own guard band.
evidence_summary: The 221-day trigger is 2.0*0.185695/sqrt(221)=0.0250, i.e. the null sd with no overlap adjustment (definition at REGISTRATION.md:208-212; code registered_floor_mde at src/npd/power.py:129-131). The closure re-sizes the design on realized dispersion to 'near 1,700 trading days' (REGISTRATION.md:716-718) but leaves Section 14 unamended, so the registered reopen trigger and the closure's own sizing differ by a factor of about eight. On the realized model daily-IC sd of 0.25159 (n 404) the same 0.025 floor needs (2*0.25159/0.025)^2 = 405 days with no overlap adjustment and about 1,377 at the registered VIF 3.4; on the realized coin-test bootstrap half-width of 0.0337 at 404 days (evaluation.md:133, :250-251) the replay window would need about 734 days. Hygiene folded in: the floor the code enforces is a day count, clears_power_floor=len(inside) >= cfg.min_trading_days (src/npd/window.py:76) with min_trading_days=200 (src/npd/config.py:80), and Section 0 fires BLOCKED on that count (src/npd/section0.py:56-61); 200 days gives 2.0*0.185695/sqrt(200)=0.02626 > 0.025, so the code's floor does not equal the registration's floor even on the registration's own arithmetic. The closure names no revised replay date and the post-anchor marker _CLOSED_DO_NOT_RUN_HERE (untracked, dated 2026-09-02, read 2026-09-03T06:30:46Z, UNANCHORED) directs successor work to a new repository, so the registered reopen path has neither a valid trigger nor an owner.
recomputation: Inputs: null sd 0.185695 (REGISTRATION.md:203-204), t 2.0 (config.py:119), VIF 3.4 (REGISTRATION.md:225), realized model IC sd 0.25159 (n 404), realized coin half-width 0.0337 (evaluation.md:250-251). Method: days = (t*sd/MDE)^2 * VIF. Results: 220.7 days (registered inputs), 750 (registered sd at VIF 3.4), 405 (realized sd, no overlap), 1,377 (realized sd at VIF 3.4), ~734 (coin half-width route); and MDE 0.02626 at the code's 200-day floor. Script scratchpad/work/agentA/recompute.py, output recompute.out (final block).
would_resolve: A numbered amendment that either re-bases Section 14's trigger on the realized sd and states the revised replay dates, or withdraws the B.3 schedule explicitly; plus a one-line correction aligning config.min_trading_days with the 221-day registered floor. Either current reading (replays fire underpowered in mid 2027, or the schedule has silently lapsed) is a defect.
confidence_why: The arithmetic is high confidence, but that the schedule is orphaned rather than merely unrevised is an inference from the closure's silence and the post-anchor marker.
invalidation_note: No commits after the anchor; a future amendment would resolve it rather than invalidate it.

hypothesis_or_artifact: The low-reasoning-effort variant named in Amendment 2 as a future registered variant, versus the Closure's 'What a powered version would cost'
label: READ
claim_quote:
Sizing against the measured 0.36339 rather than the registered assumption requires roughly **four times the evaluable days**, landing near **1,700 trading days** of post-cutoff window.

**No model has one.** The window would have to accumulate from the calendar at about 21 trading days a month.
evidence_summary: The closure prices exactly one route to a powered result, calendar accumulation to about 1,700 days, and declares it unavailable. It does not mention the variant the registration itself named seven amendments earlier (REGISTRATION.md:493-496), nor the 3.0622 USD left under the cap (REGISTRATION.md:789-790), nor what that variant would cost now that Amendment 4's strict schema is in force. Ledger-measured cost of the 70 low attempts under the in-force digest (live ledgers/evidence.jsonl, read 2026-09-03T06:35:37Z, UNANCHORED): mean 0.03735 USD per attempt, mean 3,110 reasoning tokens, 53 of 70 attempts stored (76 percent), mean latency 31.5 s. A full 432-day low collection projects to about 16.1 USD at one attempt per day and about 21.3 USD at the realized 1.32 attempts per stored low day; the 365-day version Amendment 2 sized (REGISTRATION.md:488-490) to about 13.6 to 18.0 USD. The binding blocker is the leftover balance, not the calendar (REGISTRATION.md:293-295). Every sentence of the closure carries the effort qualifier (session_a1_b1.md:261-263; REGISTRATION.md:483-486), and the only in-sample datum on that qualifier, the split of AUDIT-A-NPDExperiment-2, reads +0.0509 on 51 low days against -0.0004 on 353 minimal days at the primary horizon: imprecise but on the hypothesis side. Honest limit: the low variant would not repair the contrast power at 432 days (the contrast-sd problem of AUDIT-A-NPDExperiment-1 is independent of effort), so its value is confined to the effort qualifier.
recomputation: Inputs: cost_usd, reasoning_tokens, state, reasoning_effort and prompt_digest per row of live ledgers/evidence.jsonl (n = 883 attempts under the in-force digest, of which 70 at low); day count 432 (REGISTRATION.md:83). Method: mean over low attempts with the in-force digest; multiply by 432 and by 432 x 70/53. Result: 16.13 USD at one attempt per day, 21.3 USD at the realized 1.32 attempts per stored low day; 365-day version 13.6 to 18.0 USD. Script scratchpad/work/agentA/supp.py, output supp.out.
would_resolve: Add to the closure's cost section the price of the named low variant (order 15 to 25 USD on the ledger's own rates) beside the 1,700-day route, and state whether it is declined on cost, on the operator decision recorded at REGISTRATION.md:710, or on the contrast-power argument. Then 'No model has one' stops reading as 'no achievable path exists'.
confidence_why: The omission and the measured cost are firm, but whether the variant is worth running is a judgement the closure is entitled to make and simply did not make.
invalidation_note: No commits after the anchor; the untracked 2026-09-02 marker says successor work belongs in a new repository, which is consistent with the variant still being open.
disclosure_ref: NPDExperiment/REGISTRATION.md:493-496 names the low-effort shortened-window variant as a natural candidate for a future registered variant, and NPDExperiment/REGISTRATION.md:710 states the closure is by operator decision, not by evidence. The authors disclosed the variant, so this finding is READ and capped at S3; what is not disclosed is its cost, and the disclosure sits in Amendment 2 rather than in the closure's cost section.
